ios.desc:
HOW DOES MTAILOR WORK?
We offer perfectly fitting custom clothing! Let our app measure you 20% more accurately than a professional tailor in just 30 seconds using your mobile device.

We offer men's custom dress shirts, suits, blazers, pants, jeans, polos, chinos, shorts and tees. 
We also offer women's custom jeans.

FREE SHIPPING & FREE RETURNS
o If you don’t like your order, we’ll refund 100% of your money, guaranteed.
o No matter what, shipping is always on us!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CLOTHING
o Pick out all the details you want with just a few taps!
